subject: Preservation of the Brooks Estate Carriage House
overview: The Council approved $200,000 to stabilize the historic Carriage House at Brooks Estate and requested several infrastructure improvements from the MBTA and Eversource. Much of the meeting focused on the need for a comprehensive city-wide capital plan and improved resident notification for major transit projects.

items.title: Green Line Extension Comment Period Notification
items.summary: The Council approved a motion to conduct a reverse 911 call and increase mailings to notify residents that the comment period for the Green Line extension project change was extended to December 12.

items.title: Bus Shelter at Roosevelt Circle Rotary
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the MBTA install a bus shelter at the South Border Road stop to improve safety and encourage ridership, despite the MBTA's stated ridership minimums. The motion included amendments to seek state delegation support and mitigation funding from concurrent Department of Transportation projects.

items.title: Community Aggregation Opt-Out Database
items.summary: A resolution to establish a pre-emptive opt-out list for future electricity aggregation plans failed because the Council felt it was premature to dedicate resources before the program itself was approved.

items.title: Infrastructure Upgrades During Eversource Construction
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to coordinate with Eversource to replace lead and outdated water pipes while streets are opened for the company's approved transmission project.

items.title: Committee Report on Eversource Transmission Project
items.summary: The Council accepted a committee report regarding a grant of location for Eversource, which included requirements for traffic plans, construction schedules, and regional communication strategies.

items.title: Brooks Estate Carriage House Stabilization Funding
items.summary: Approved the transfer of $200,000 from free cash to shore up the structurally failing Carriage House at the Brooks Estate. The approval was made contingent upon the administration providing a comprehensive city-wide capital plan within six months to address broader infrastructure needs like fire stations and roads.

items.title: Meeting Cancellation and Ceremonial Business
items.summary: The Council voted to cancel the December 26 regular meeting and acknowledged volunteers involved in the Jingle Bell Festival and the recent election recount.
